notes: Partition-by-private-sale statute for absentee co-owners; no letting/lodging of dwellings at issue.
Jurisdiction/venue dispute over batture-land expropriation for levee purposes; no compensated occupancy of a dwelling at issue.

holding_summary: The court found defendant's inclusion as nominal copurchaser was in truth a disguised onerous donation, given in exchange for a promise of lifelong room, board, laundry and care; because defendant failed to continue providing that care after plaintiff left the home, the donation was revoked and plaintiff decreed sole owner of the property.

quotes.text: under an arrangement by which he paid Mr. and Mrs. Dulcich $35 a month for room and board.
moved into the home of Mr. and Mrs. Ritchie as a paying guest.
the transaction, although disguised as a sale in which he was named as a copurchaser, was in truth and in fact an onerous donation.
defendant failed to comply with the conditions of the donation.

notes: Householder (Dulcich) took in a paying boarder for $35/month room-and-board before the disputed property deal; plaintiff later again became a 'paying guest' elsewhere. Arrangement treated as wholly ordinary and lawful; central holding concerns onerous donation, not the letting itself.
Personal-injury/premises-liability case about invitee vs. licensee status of a business visitor at a bottling plant; no dwelling letting involved.
Tenant-vs-landlord repair-duty case (defective gallery plank); plaintiff's rooming-house business mentioned only to compute lost income, not adjudicated as to its legal character or lawfulness.
Party-wall window/servitude dispute under zoning ordinance; no compensated occupancy of dwellings involved.
Zoning-ordinance prosecution over a backyard horseshoe-pitching game in a residential district; no lodging/letting issue.

holding_summary: In rejecting a claim that a neighboring laundry's machinery constituted a vibration/noise nuisance, the court weighed the character of the neighborhood, noting that the plaintiff's own building's upper floors were leased and operated as a rooming house whose lodgers slept during the day, and that the laundry ran only during business hours, so no injunction against the laundry's operation was warranted.

quotes.text: leased and used for a rooming house, catering to a class of unconventional patrons whose occupations induced them to lodge in a busy section of the city, and to do their sleeping in the daytime.
They are the only class of sleepers whose rest could be disturbed by the Oriental Laundry, because it is never in operation at night or on Sundays.

notes: Upper floors of a commercial-district building leased to an operator running a rooming house is treated as an ordinary, unremarked lawful use; case's core holding is about nuisance from machinery vibration, not the legality of the rooming house itself.
Commercial store lease dispute over rent diminution following levee/street reconstruction; no dwelling letting or lodging involved.
Ordinance regulating uninvited door-to-door solicitors/peddlers, upheld as police-power measure protecting the home; not about letting or lodging of dwellings.
Possessory action between family members over a store/residence building following a purported lease to a stepson; no compensated-occupancy characterization at issue.
Boundary-fixing action holding a farm lessee is not a necessary/proper party; no dwelling lodging or letting involved.

Movable-vs-immovable classification dispute over air conditioners/outbuildings on a sold home; only a passing treatise quote mentions a house 'leased furnished,' with no bearing on the character or regulation of compensated occupancy.
Zoning special-permit dispute over construction of a Knights of Columbus fraternal 'lodge hall'; this is a private-club meeting hall, not a lodging house for paying occupants.
Plaintiff resided with her mother as an unpaid family guest (invitee) after losing her own home; no compensation for occupancy, so not a letting/lodging arrangement.
Mandamus action over a permit to erect a gasoline filling station on nonconforming-use commercial land; no dwelling letting or lodging involved.
Tort suit over a footbridge collapse during a paid tour of a historic plantation house; a museum-style day visitation attraction, not overnight lodging/letting of a dwelling.
Verbal farm/rice-crop lease dispute between landowner and tenant farmer; agricultural land lease, not dwelling/lodging occupancy.
